scenario: AITA for calling and chewing out the Reverend | AITA for calling and chewing out the reverend of my wifes church. I ended up calling and essentially saying that those that contributed nothing or little should not be shamed with a number game sent in the mail. Anyhow I feel like an asshole for taking this to the extreme with them.
